scope: Bounded primary-source review beyond DSeq-JEPA; research-agent findings, not a causal diagnosis of the OCT runs

studies.title: US-JEPA: A Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Ultrasound
studies.objective: Latent patch Smooth-L1 prediction with a frozen URFM teacher and SALT adaptation
studies.guide: Deterministic valid-ultrasound-content envelope, not organ segmentation or SAM
studies.intervention: Region conditioning changes both context and target support; intensity rescaling is also region-conditioned
studies.metric: Downstream macro-F1 percent; means across five probe seeds, not established independent pretraining replications
studies.interpretation: Genuine medical JEPA guidance gains on four tasks and losses on four. Does not isolate target placement at matched delivered token budgets.

studies.title: What to Hide from Your Students: Attention-Guided Masked Image Modeling
studies.objective: iBOT dense teacher-student feature-distribution prediction plus global/multi-crop distillation; not pixel reconstruction or canonical I-JEPA-only regression
studies.intervention: Highest-attention versus random selected patch targets with the same nominal mask-ratio distribution
studies.interpretation: Relatively clean positive evidence for important-target selection in latent prediction. Effect depends on masking strength and training regime; global distillation remains different from this OCT pipeline.

studies.title: Causal-JEPA: Learning World Models through Object-Level Latent Masking
studies.objective: Predict masked history slots and future object slots with L2, using a frozen object-centric encoder
studies.guide: VideoSAUR or SAVi object slots, not SAM
studies.context: Earliest identity anchor and other visible object histories are retained
studies.source: Appendix K and Table A4, pages 21-23
studies.interpretation: Masking can strongly help a latent world model without object-aware masks dominating budget-matched alternatives. Frozen-encoder dynamics learning is not OCT encoder pretraining.

studies.title: A-JEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture Can Listen
studies.objective: L2 latent spectrogram prediction with an EMA teacher
studies.guide: Time/frequency coordinate prior, not learned semantic saliency
studies.intervention: Curriculum changes target count/geometry and expands context exclusion along time/frequency bands
studies.interpretation: Positive structural-curriculum control with a negative reversed curriculum; not a selection-only semantic-guidance result.

excluded_conflations.reason: Uses random feature-map patches in a mask-classification architecture; its name does not imply SAM-generated pretraining masks. Includes a pixel denoising objective.
Keeps I-JEPA block masking and changes semantic target construction/aggregation, not anatomical mask locations.

sam_search.result: No genuine SAM-generated-mask plus JEPA pretraining method verified in this bounded search
sam_search.limitation: Not evidence that none exists; an additional OpenReview lead was inaccessible.

overall_limit: These studies motivate hypotheses and demonstrate both positive guidance effects and conditional failures. None determines the cause of the local COVER or ANATOMY AUC trajectory.
